location_lifecycle.label: Property & Space Lifecycle
location_lifecycle.help: Operational lifecycle of a property, building, or physical space. Occupancy, booking availability, and record activation are separate.

planned.help: The property, building, or physical space is being prepared and has not started operating.

operational.help: The property, building, or physical space is operating. This does not indicate vacant space or booking availability.

under_maintenance.help: The property, building, or physical space is undergoing maintenance; operating restrictions are managed separately.

temporarily_closed.help: Operations at the property, building, or physical space are paused with an intention to reopen.

closed.help: Operations have ended at the property, building, or physical space.
